title: Complexity reduction in online stochastic Newton methods with potential O(N d) total cost
summary: Optimizing smooth convex functions in stochastic settings, where only noisy estimates of gradients and Hessians are available, is a fundamental problem in optimization. While first-order methods possess a low per-iteration cost, their convergence is slow for ill-conditioned problems. Stochastic Newton methods utilize second-order information to correct for local curvature, but the O(d 3 ) per-iteration cost of computing and inverting a full Hessian, where d is the problem dimension, is prohibitive in high dimensions.
